subtitle.en: Sign in to follow your pieces as they are made.
subtitle.ar: سجّلي الدخول لتتابعي قطعكِ وهي تُصنع.
subtitle.tr: Parçalarınızı yapılırken izlemek için giriş yapın.

children.name: Every piece starts with a yarn and a hand that knows your name

children.text: Every piece starts with a yarn and a hand that knows your name

ar.text: كل قطعة تبدأ بخيط ويدٍ تعرف اسمكِ

tr.text: Her parça bir iple ve adınızı bilen bir elle başlar

children.text: Order your piece, choose its colour, and we make it for you in 10 days.

ar.text: اطلبي قطعتكِ واختاري لونها، ونصنعها لكِ في 10 أيام.

tr.text: Parçanızı sipariş edin, rengini seçin; 10 günde sizin için yapalım.

children.text: Made for you alone, stitch by stitch

ar.text: تُصنع لكِ وحدكِ، غرزة بعد غرزة

children.text: “I like to know who I'm making it for: I write her name on the card before I start.”

ar.text: «أحب أن أعرف لمن أصنع القطعة؛ أكتب اسمها على البطاقة قبل أن أبدأ.»

tr.text: “Kimin için yaptığımı bilmek isterim: başlamadan önce adını karta yazarım.”

children.text: Every piece, signed by its maker

children.name: Each piece is wrapped by hand, with a card from its maker.

children.text: Each piece is wrapped by hand, with a card from its maker.

ar.text: تُغلَّف كل قطعة باليد مع بطاقة من صانعتها.

tr.text: Her parça elle sarılır, yapanın kartıyla gelir.

entries.title: Order received
entries.text: We confirm the colour and the size with you.

tr.title: Sipariş alındı
tr.text: Rengi ve bedeni sizinle teyit ediyoruz.

entries.title: On the hook
entries.text: Your maker is crocheting your piece by hand.

entries.title: Wrapped
entries.text: Your piece is checked and wrapped, its card written.

tr.title: Paketlendi
tr.text: Parçanız kontrol edildi, paketlendi ve kartı yazıldı.

entries.title: On its way
entries.text: Your piece is on its way to your door.

children.name: Search a piece, a maker, a yarn…
children.text: Search a piece, a maker, a yarn…

ar.text: ابحثي عن قطعة أو صانعة أو خيط…

tr.text: Parça, zanaatkâr ya da ip arayın…

children.text: Write to the makers about your piece
Tell the makers what you want: the piece, its size and the yarn's colour. A maker writes back within a day with the price and the days it takes.

ar.text: أخبري الصانعات بما تريدين: القطعة ومقاسها ولون خيطها. تردّ عليكِ صانعة خلال يوم بالسعر وعدد أيام الصنع.

tr.text: Ne istediğinizi yazın: parça, ölçüsü ve ipin rengi. Bir zanaatkâr bir gün içinde fiyat ve süreyle döner.

children.text: Made for you alone, stitch by stitch

ar.text: تُصنع لكِ وحدكِ، غرزة بعد غرزة

form.success_text: Thank you! We have your request and will contact you soon with the price and the time.

children.text: She makes each piece to order in her home studio.

ar.text: تصنع كل قطعة عند الطلب في مرسمها المنزلي.

tr.text: Her parçayı evindeki atölyede siparişe göre yapıyor.

children.text: Made for you alone, stitch by stitch

ar.text: تُصنع لكِ وحدكِ، غرزة بعد غرزة
